body.en: You notice the gutter right outside your house is blocked with plastic waste, and rain clouds are building overhead. What's the best action?

choices.label: Clear the blockage now, before the rain starts
choices.consequence: Right move. A blocked gutter right at your door floods your own house first — clearing it takes minutes and protects your home directly, before the rain even starts.

choices.label: Leave it — clearing drains is the municipal assembly's job, not yours
choices.consequence: Costly wait. City drainage teams can't reach every gutter before every storm — the water blocked right outside your own door is the water that floods your own floor first.

choices.label: Add more waste on top since it's already blocked anyway
choices.consequence: Makes it worse. Adding to a blocked drain guarantees the water has nowhere to go at all when the rain arrives.
